fallbacks.when: Never for the subscriber request itself — this is a verified native write surface. Only source fields with nowhere to land (e.g. a custom quantity-wanted field some plugins carry) fall back to a notes/CMS-archive entry, not the request record.

pitfalls.summary: VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27: create answers 428 REQUEST_COLLECTION_DISABLED until Start Collecting Requests (POST .../settings/start-collecting { appId: Wix Stores }) has run; it is the setup step start-back-in-stock-collection, verified by Get Settings (a PUT with an empty body) showing collectingRequests true for the Stores app id. createBackInStockRequest rethrows the 428 with code BACK_IN_STOCK_COLLECTION_DISABLED: a setup failure, not a per-row retry. Collecting also shows the "Notify When Available" button on out-of-stock products.

catalogReference.catalogItemId must be a real Wix Stores Catalog V3 product/variant id. Sequence this entity strictly after stores/product (and its crosswalk) in the import order; a source product id can never be passed through directly.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27: a duplicate (catalogReference, email) while the first request is still RECEIVED answers 409 BACK_IN_STOCK_NOTIFICATION_REQUEST_ALREADY_EXISTS with no id (the docs prose claiming a 200 with the existing request is wrong). Query filters on status only: filters on contactId, email, id, itemUrl and catalogReference.catalogItemId are all refused (400 FILTER_PARSER_VALIDATION). createBackInStockRequest recovers by paging status RECEIVED and matching email + catalogItemId + variantId client-side; no single match leaves the row deferred (back-in-stock-duplicate-unresolved), never an invented id. After a request is NOTIFICATION_SENT, a new create for the same pair succeeds as a new RECEIVED request.

Unlike most bulk-import writes in this domain, creating a request does NOT email the customer — only an actual restock (or the offline Mark As Notification Sent call) does. No disableNotifications-equivalent flag exists or is needed; historical import is safe by default.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27: a request for an email with no contact created a new contact (contactId returned); an email that already had a contact reused it. Back-in-stock volume is CRM contact volume: show the count in the plan before consent.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27: the settings endpoints answer 401 "TPA 16be6c71-d061-4f56-8cda-c6aa911d1832 is not installed" on a Stores site until that app is installed (the install-wix-back-in-stock setup step). Create also needs itemDetails.name and itemDetails.price (400 REQUIRED_FIELD without them).
VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27: a request for an item that is in stock is accepted (RECEIVED). No stock-based filter is applied: notifications are handled by the site mute.

mappingGuidance: Dependencies: stores/product per record (request.catalogReference.catalogItemId). No crm/contact dependency: the request carries only an email, and Wix matches or creates the contact itself (creates-a-contact); the crm/contact upsert matches by email, so the order of the two imports does not matter and a contact task that did not finish never holds the requests.
Map source subscriber email -> request.email (required, EMAIL format).

Map source product/variation id, after crosswalk, -> request.catalogReference.catalogItemId; always set request.catalogReference.appId to the fixed Wix Stores app id 215238eb-22a5-4c36-9e7b-e7c08025e04e.
A source variation-level subscription -> request.catalogReference.options.variantId (Catalog V3 option/variant id, post-crosswalk), not a separate entity.

itemDetails.name and itemDetails.price are required on every create call and are NOT stored fields on the request's own read shape (they only feed the notification template) -- pull them from the already-imported product at write time, not from any source data.
request.itemUrl should be the live Wix product page URL once known; omit if not yet resolvable rather than guessing.

Import every source subscription. A row the source already notified (mail-sent) is created and then marked with Mark As Notification Sent (offline, sends nothing): pass notified: true to createBackInStockRequest. A marked request no longer blocks a duplicate create, so a re-run of a record whose request id is known (journal or crosswalk target, including outcome mark-unverified) passes knownRequestId: the request is read and finished, never created again. Unsubscribed rows are not subscriptions and are not imported; record each in the faithfulness ledger so the omission is visible.
setupRequirements: Back in Stock app installed (appDefId 16be6c71-d061-4f56-8cda-c6aa911d1832) - setup step install-wix-back-in-stock
Request collection started - setup step start-back-in-stock-collection
